label: WeCom (企业微信)
terms_note: Automation allowed for the user's own enterprise through a self-built app (自建应用): GET /cgi-bin/gettoken?corpid&corpsecret → access_token (7200 s, cache it). Send app message POST https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/message/send?access_token=… — touser ≤1,000 members, toparty ≤100 departments, totag ≤100 tags, or @all; types text / image / voice / video / file / textcard / news / mpnews / markdown / miniprogram_notice / template_card (text notice, news, button, vote, multi-select, with callbacks); limits: per app ≤ (licensed seat cap × 200) deliveries per day, per member 30 messages / minute and 1,000 / hour; duplicate-check window default 1,800 s; errcode with HTTP 200 (unlicenseduser, invaliduser …), msgid returned for recall. Customer-facing messaging (外部联系人 / 微信客服) has its own 48-hour window and per-day group-message caps (registry note) — read on the 2026-09-02 pass, not re-opened today.

sdks: No official SDK required — HTTPS + access_token; callbacks use the WeCom AES encryption scheme (developer.work.weixin.qq.com)

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.endpoint: POST /cgi-bin/kf/sync_msg (微信客服 cursor sync); app messages arrive only on the encrypted XML callback

endpoints.notes: totag, msgtype, agentid, <msgtype>{…}, safe, enable_duplicate_check, duplicate_check_interval}`

endpoints.call: msgtypes: text, image, voice, video, file, textcard, news, mpnews, markdown, miniprogram_notice, template_card (text_notice, news_notice, button_interaction, vote_interaction, multiple_interaction)
endpoints.notes: template_card callbacks via the app callback

endpoints.call: /cgi-bin/externalcontact/*` (list, get, add_msg_template for customer-group mass messages)
Callback (encrypted XML / JSON) for messages + events

reference.limits: - All responses carry `errcode` (0 = ok) even with HTTP 200; 45009 = frequency limit → `RateLimited`. - Messaging your own enterprise's members and consented external contacts is the product; cross-enterprise cold outreach is not possible (WeChat users must add the enterprise / talk to 微信客服 first). - `unlicenseduser` errors = members without a licence cannot be reached.

adapter.envelope_note: Every response carries errcode ('为0表示成功，非0表示调用失败') and errmsg inside HTTP 200; non-zero codes become isError results. An expired token arrives the same way (errcode 42001 'access_token已过期' in HTTP 200), not as a 401, so the runtime's 401 re-login never fires: the token is refreshed by its TTL (expires_in 7200 s minus the runtime's 30 s margin).

fields.name: corpid
fields.help: Enterprise ID (我的企业 > 企业信息), sent with corpsecret to GET https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/gettoken; the returned access_token (7200 s) travels as the access_token query parameter of every call.

fields.name: corpsecret
fields.help: Secret of the self-built app (应用管理 > 应用 > Secret); each app has its own secret and token. Do not call gettoken frequently (rate-limited); the runtime caches the token.

config_fields.name: agent_id
config_fields.help: AgentId (integer) of the self-built app shown on its settings page; required by message/send and agent/get.

me.note: agent/get: the app's name, description, allow_userinfos, visibility; verifies corpid/corpsecret and agent_id together.

send.note: App text message: `to` is one or more member UserIDs joined with '|' (max 1,000) or @all; content up to 2,048 bytes. Per app ≤ 30 messages/minute and 1,000/hour to the same member. Recipients that could not be reached come back in raw.invaliduser / unlicenseduser with errcode 0; message_id is msgid (for recall). `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

not_offered.list_inbound: Messages sent to an app arrive only on the encrypted XML callback URL (https://developer.work.weixin.qq.com/document/path/90238); kf/sync_msg covers only the separate 微信客服 (customer service) product.
not_offered.get_thread: No conversation-history API exists for app messages: they are pushed to the app's callback URL only (https://developer.work.weixin.qq.com/document/path/90238); chat archiving (会话内容存档) is a separately licensed SDK product, not a REST call.
not_offered.reply: App messages have no threads; reply with send to the member's UserID (https://developer.work.weixin.qq.com/document/path/90236).
not_offered.mark_read: No read-state API for app messages (https://developer.work.weixin.qq.com/document/path/90236).

evidence: host qyapi.weixin.qq.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert, Inc.)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
